description: `multiverse tasks` reads routing.log dispatch records written with OLD (pre-rename) dispatch-path role names (fixer/oracle/reviewer, per spec-tests-harness.md's role-rename note) straight off disk, with no [roles.*] config table for any of them and zero live Herdr agents. Three hand-seeded tasks exercise three TaskState outcomes a history reader must reproduce byte-for-byte: a fully recorded (dispatch+started+result) done task, an unrecorded task (status file written but no event=result line yet — the dispatch process died or raced ahead of the agent), and a bare dispatch with no started/status/result at all. Every record predates the v=1/seq/crc32 envelope: event=dispatch/started/result lines never carried that envelope even in the current Python writer (accounts.py's dispatch_log_line/started_log_line/append_result_log), unlike message/backlog records.
